Results.ReviewText:
Garbage!!!  A complete waste of time and money.  I decided to purchase this brush cutter based on price and modest reviews.  I accepted the mediocre reviews part because my needs are nominal.  I only plan to use this twice a year for moderate tasks with no substantial heavy-duty stuff involved.  
The brush cutter arrived and I put it together per the instructions and with tips from online videos.  As soon as I started the unit, it vibrated so violently that I could barely hold it.  I went through the assembly process again to make sure everything was correctly attached.  Still the shaking and rattling persisted.  Plastic pieces and parts were flying off the unit as soon as it started and vibrated.  I figured I must have gotten a bad one and I would give a replacement a try.  
The replacement lasted one pull of the starter cord which did not retract.  What a disappointment!
I have called customer service, 1-844-786-7335, four times in the past two weeks.  The first time I left a message.  The second time I waited for about an hour before hanging up.  The third and fourth calls resulted in me taking the call back option.  I have yet to be contacted by anyone from Wild Badger.
Needless to say, this piece of junk is going back to the retailer, again.  As their customer service is non-existent, I will be sure to avoid any products from Wild Badger (and Sunseeker, the Chinese parent company) in the future.  
Bottom line:  This is another lesson in the value of paying more for quality and avoiding products with mediocre reviews.
Results.Title: Wild Badger 52cc Brush Cutter Review – Garbage!!

Results.OriginalProductName: Gas 52-cc 2-cycle 17-in Straight Shaft Gas String Trimmer
Results.ReviewText: Using the triangular bush cutter blade, I just fired it up and ran two full tanks of gas through it.  It performed flawlessly.  Despite reviews I've read elsewhere, nothing vibrated loose, everything worked as it should.  I was able to cut everything from raspberry vines to small saplings. Even in the thicket of vines it never once got tangled and powered through just about everything.  I am more than satisfied with this bush cutter.  Anybody in the market for a gently used DR mower?
